تعلوطون (form XIII)
# تَعْلَوِّطُونَ (taʕlawwiṭūna) /taʕ.law.wi.tˤuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِعْلَوَّطَ (iʕlawwaṭa)
# تُعْلَوَّطُونَ (tuʕlawwaṭūna) /tuʕ.law.wa.tˤuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِعْلَوَّطَ (iʕlawwaṭa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
